result_summary: CONFIRMED DECISIVELY both markets; IC_fwdvol RETIRED as an estimator-selection metric. Across 10 variants on one common sample (n=33389), IC_fwdvol is a near-perfect linear function of corr_lvl (how level-like the variant is): R2=0.992 on BOTH NQ and ES, slope ~0.90, intercept ~0. VIX is the first input this project has tested that is NOT past price. KT3's cross-market asymmetry does hold - ES (+0.0972) gets ~2x what NQ (+0.0656) does, as predicted because VIX is an SPX measure and only a proxy for the Nasdaq - so what is being measured genuinely is implied-vol content, merely too small to matter. THE MECHANISM IS REVERSED, identically on both markets (EXP-0017b, post-hoc): the hypothesis was ANTICIPATION (implied rich vs realised = the pre-announcement signature), but core_vix-minus-core by premium quintile is MONOTONE DECREASING - q1 +0.2220 NQ / +0.2746 ES (implied unusually CHEAP) down to q5 +0.0189/+0.0121 (implied richest). VIX pays most right AFTER a realised-vol spike, where the past-price core over-extrapolates (its skill there is -0.187/-0.203, WORSE than persistence) and a slow daily-scale level pulls the forecast back. VIX IS AN ANCHOR, NOT AN ANTICIPATOR. Three confirmations: (a) the 13:59 slot forecasting the 14:00-14:30 FOMC window is VIX's WORST slot (+0.0004 NQ / +0.0237 ES) while the MORNING slots are its best (+0.1678/+0.2028 NQ at 09:59/10:29), i.e. it helps where past-price state is thinnest, not where events are scheduled; (b) by decile of the core's own error VIX makes the EASY calls worse (d1-d5, -0.18..-0.05) and the HARD calls better (d7-d10, +0.04..+0.13) - a redistribution, not a uniform gain; (c) even in VIX's best cell (q1) core_levels3 matches it (+0.0381 NQ vs +0.0351), so the anchoring job is done as well by a longer REALISED window. STRUCTURE, reproducing prior findings in a new domain: the naive variance risk premium log(implied30/realised30) is -0.857/-0.843 correlated with its own DENOMINATOR because VIX barely moves across a 30-minute clock = finding H in a new costume, and the bare denominator (|IC| 0.845) beats the ratio (|IC| 0.611); residualising the premium on realised leaves the VIX level plus noise, so there is NO separate premium dimension.
